key_facts: Saildrone received a new $16.3 million Navy task order to continue counter-drug operations in the Caribbean and Eastern Pacific into 2027.
Saildrone Voyager USVs have supported SOUTHCOM's Joint Interagency Task Force South since 2023.
A Voyager helped track a suspicious vessel in the Caribbean in October 2025, leading to the interdiction of roughly $81 million of cocaine.
Saildrone announced in February 2025 that 20 Voyagers were at sea supporting the Navy in the region.
Saildrone has also teamed with the Coast Guard, deploying 16 Voyagers to the Great Lakes and North Atlantic for border security and illegal fishing enforcement.
